title: The Queen of Serpents

full_text:
In ancient Cairo lived a gentle young woodcutter named Hasib Karim al-Din, who was abandoned by deceitful companions at the bottom of a deep subterranean cistern. Exploring the dark caverns in search of an exit, Hasib opened a crevice in the rock wall and emerged into an underground paradise of breathtaking wonder.

Before him lay emerald meadows illuminated by glowing crystals, with rivers of clear water and trees bearing fruits of jade and amber. In the center, upon a throne of solid gold, rested Yamlika, the wise Queen of the Serpents, a creature of supernatural grace and ancient learning whose voice was melodious as running water.

Thousands of serpents of every color bowed before her in peaceful order. Queen Yamlika welcomed Hasib with gentle courtesy, fed him delicious sweetmeats, and sheltered him in her subterranean realm for two years, instructing him in the medicinal properties of every plant and the secrets of the ancient kings.

When Hasib longed to return to his aged mother in Cairo, Queen Yamlika granted him leave, but exacted one sacred promise: 'Go in peace, Hasib; but swear an oath that you will never enter a public bathhouse, for if water touches your skin in public, the royal doctors of the Sultan will recognize the serpentine luminescence upon your flesh, and will force you to reveal the entrance to my sanctuary!'

Hasib swore the sacred covenant and returned to his mother, living in modest comfort.

Years later, when the King of Persia fell afflicted with an incurable malady, the court astrologers declared that his only cure was a potion prepared from the Queen of Serpents. The vizier arrested all citizens whose skin shone with subterranean light.

Though captured and threatened with death, Hasib remembered Yamlika's wisdom, using her teachings to cure the king without harming the gentle Queen of Serpents, preserving his honor and becoming the Chief Physician of the empire.
moral: Honoring solemn oaths, respecting nature, and preserving ancient secrets bring protection and wisdom.
